testimonials.text: I really liked the templates and care the organizers took to help us build a low resource endotrainer; also I wouldn't have imagined I could use a bed sheet to simulate the small bowel and mesentery. I agree that management and handling of small bowel is a skill young surgeons don't feel too comfortable at the beginning and it must be thoroughly developed.
The guide on how to set up my own box trainer, that's very considerate especially for someone like me from Uganda who can't easily access one. Thank you so much team.
Case scenario is very interesting way to learn.
